contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The wired earbuds and cable are a scene prop, not a product. Both hands at the zip cover part of the jacket front, and the jacket back and hidden side are conservatively reconstructed. Only the neck and hem of the gray tee show, so its hidden front is inferred. The cuffs are the jacket's own orange elastic. The black shorts and full-length tights are separate products. The watch strap is partly hidden by the wrist. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

intro.ko: 이어폰 선이 지퍼에 걸려 잠깐 멈추고 두 손을 모읍니다.

body.ko: 흰 어깨 반사선의 오렌지 재킷 아래 회색 반팔 티가 보입니다. 검정 쇼츠와 긴 타이츠는 독립된 두 층으로 이어지고 흰 양말과 러닝화가 발끝을 밝힙니다. 검정 원형 시계 옆 손이 작은 걸림을 풀고, 직광 플래시는 얇은 재킷의 주름을 또렷하게 남깁니다.
body.en: A gray tee shows below the orange jacket with white shoulder lines. Black shorts and long tights remain two independent layers, ending in white socks and runners. A hand beside the round black watch frees the small snag; direct flash defines the thin jacket folds.
body.de: Ein graues Shirt zeigt sich unter der orangefarbenen Jacke mit weißen Schulterlinien. Schwarze Shorts und lange Tight bleiben zwei eigene Lagen, gefolgt von weißen Socken und Laufschuhen. Neben der schwarzen Runduhr löst eine Hand den Haken; direkter Blitz zeichnet die dünnen Jackenfalten.
